lines.say: Level thirty two! Dict, and set comprehensions!
Same trick, curly brackets! Key, colon, value, then the loop!

lines.say: Colon means key and value. That makes a dictionary!

lines.say: No colon? You get a set! All three have six letters, so just one six!
lines.cap: No colon? You get a set! All 3 have 6 letters, so just one 6!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
